issues.title: Ingest Pike County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $10,598,540 across 26 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($5,275,085), County Road Fund ($2,204,715), Solid Waste Fund ($1,792,129). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
